author: Computing Forever
description:
I think 2019 is an interesting year to look back on from the point of view of what audiences were willing to accept from Hollywood movies. 2026 shows us that what worked in 2019, wouldn't work today. I doubt Captain Marvel or Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker would make nearly as much money today as they did back then. Audience expectations have changed and they are now much more discerning and vigilant when it comes to anything they perceive as woke from a new movie. Here are some of my thoughts and how that might affect future films, including the upcoming fantasy epic, The Odyssey.
